 News Sangeeth Prathap pens emotional note: 'I am choosing never to rewatch Dorothy' 
 Helmed by Karthik Subbaraj, Dorothy stars Sananth, Rishikanth, and Keerthy Suresh in the lead roles Sangeeth Prathap (L) and a poster for Dorothy (R) Cinema Express Desk Updated on :  09 Nov 2026, 12:18 pm 
 Copied 
 Premalu -fame Sangeeth Prathap expresses his admiration for Karthik Subbaraj’s Dorothy in an appreciation post on social media. The actor shared that the film touched him deeply and that he had decided never to rewatch it.
 Sangeeth said, "I am choosing to never rewatch Dorothy . It gave me the best two and a half hours of my life. And I know nothing will ever compare to the magic of that first time."
 A screenshot of Sangeeth Prathap's note for Dorothy Helmed by Karthik Subbaraj, Dorothy  stars Sananth, Rishikanth, and Keerthy Suresh in the lead roles. The film follows the story of two friends, portrayed by Sananth and Rishikanth, whose lives are changed later after the arrival of the Keerthy Suresh character named Dorothy.
 The film received widespread critical acclaim and appreciation from audiences and critics for its LGBTQIA+ representation and was a box-office success.  Dorothy  has music composed by Ilaiyaraaja, and cinematography by Thirunavukarasu. The film also premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 11 and had its theatrical release on September 25. 
 Dorothy Movie Review: A tender take on the violence of conforming
 Sangeeth Prathap, who was last seen in Bethlehem Kudumba Unit , also made his debut as a lead actor in It's a Medical Miracle , which released in September.
 On the other hand, actor Sangeeth Prathap welcomed a baby girl with his wife Ancy, on November 4.
